name: Mortis (Path of the Four Humours) — 2 Intermediate — Dark Humours

system.description:
You can direct each of the Four Humours much as regular Cainites direct blood. Once prepared, bringing it into contact with a victim (by touch, coating a weapon, or introducing it into food or drink) subjects them to its effect, at the cost of altering your own balance to behave contrary to that humour.

Select a Humour, expend two Blood Traits to transform it, then deliver it to a victim. The victim must win a Static Physical Challenge against your Physical Traits or fall under the humour's sway until the next sunrise; winning renders the humour inert.

Phlegm: the victim becomes lethargic, one Trait down on all Physical Challenges. Blood: the victim becomes prone to excessive bleeding, taking an additional level of damage each time they receive lethal or aggravated damage; blood prepared this way no longer functions as vitae. Black Bile: causes a level of aggravated damage to anyone (other than you) who comes into contact with it, and a second level the following turn unless a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five Traits) is won. Yellow Bile: the victim is plagued with melancholy visions, loses a Willpower Trait, and may not spend Willpower while affected.
